title: Why college degrees are becoming worthless in 2026

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 60% of employers now ignore college degrees?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI and automation are changing the job market faster than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: A college degree no longer guarantees a job in tech, healthcare, or finance.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Companies like Google and IBM now hire based on skills, not degrees.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Millions of graduates are struggling to find work in their fields.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The real value is in certifications, coding bootcamps, and hands-on experience.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one skill you can learn today that could replace a degree?
